note_on_kept_hop2_edge_gap._doc: These 8 hop2 episodes are NOT excluded. Their dependency chain is real (present in the dataset's own per-fact dependency_source field, 6/8 also in dependency_edges_used) but the v3-frozen graph fails to discover the connecting edge.
